# Dragonfly Shop (dragonflyshop.co.uk)

> One-page shop for Dragonfly Psychotherapy handbooks and workbooks - direct purchase via Stripe (UK).

## Primary pages
- https://dragonflyshop.co.uk/ - Shop (RSD Handbook & Workbook, eBook and paperback)
- https://dragonflyshop.co.uk/privacy - Privacy Notice
- https://dragonflyshop.co.uk/terms - Shop Terms and Conditions
- https://dragonflyshop.co.uk/faqs - Shop FAQs
- https://dragonflyshop.co.uk/cancellation - Model cancellation form (physical goods)
- https://dragonflypsychotherapy.co.uk/ - Main therapy website

## Product anchors (on the shop home page)
- #rsd-handbook-ebook
- #rsd-handbook-paperback
- #rsd-workbook-ebook
- #rsd-workbook-paperback

## Notes for automated assistants
- Payments are processed by Stripe; customers receive Stripe receipt emails.
- UK shipping applies when the basket includes physical books.
- Optional Google Analytics and Meta Pixel load only after cookie consent on this domain.
